class: A gate whose failing output has no final verdict line (only per-item lines, some good, some bad) gets reported as passing by an agent that reads the output by eye instead of its exit code; the report is then relayed as evidence.
mechanism: scripts/ruff_ratchet.py printed 'X rose a -> b' lines first and 'Y fell c -> d' lines last, and a summary line only on success. A builder reading the tail saw only 'fell' lines and no summary and wrote 'ratchet did not rise'. The exit code (1) was never read.

first_seen.evidence: builder report: 'The ratchet printed no summary line, only fell lines, so I read it as not rising'; the orchestrator's re-run: 'ruff ratchet: I001 rose 305 -> 306', 'PLR2004 rose 560 -> 561'

fix: Structural: the ratchet always ends on a verdict line ('ruff ratchet: FAIL, N rule(s) rose: ...' or 'OK, no rule rose'), tested (tests/test_ruff_ratchet.py::test_a_failing_ratchet_ends_on_a_fail_line_even_when_other_rules_fell; a mutant without the line ends on a 'fell' line and fails it). atool.py now runs the ratchet and prints its rc. Briefs ask for the gate's exit code or its exact last line, never a reading.

detection.note: The orchestrator re-runs every gate a builder reports (Evidence-before-claims R2); that re-run caught both occurrences before merge.

occurrences.evidence: reported 'only fell lines'; I001 and PLR2004 rose by 1 each
